# Go's &^ (AND NOT) maps to the simd AndNot method, x.AndNot(y) being x &^ y. The
# operands are unequal so that a swapped pair would show. Feasible is the shape of
# gonum's graph coloring loop, on a named slice type.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

type Colors []uint64

func AndNotUint64s(dst, a, b []uint64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] &^ b[i]
	}
}

func AndNotInPlace(dst []int32, mask []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] &^= mask[i]
	}
}

func AndNotScalar(dst, a []byte, mask byte) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] &^ mask
	}
}

func Feasible(feasible, used, adjacent Colors) {
	for w := range feasible {
		feasible[w] = used[w] &^ adjacent[w]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

type Colors []uint64

func AndNotUint64s(dst, a, b []uint64) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, len(dst), 0, len(a)) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, 0, len(dst), 0, len(b)) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] &^ b[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3 := a[:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint64s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c3)
					_v1.AndNot(_v2).Store(_c1)
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v3.AndNot(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v5.AndNot(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
					_v7.AndNot(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadUint64s(_w2[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadUint64s(_w3[_i:])
					_v9.AndNot(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadUint64sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadUint64sPart(_w3[_i:])
					_v11.AndNot(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func AndNotInPlace(dst []int32, mask []int32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, mask, 0, len(dst), 0, len(mask)) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] &^= mask[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = mask[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := mask[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_v1.AndNot(_v2).Store(_c1)
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v3.AndNot(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v5.AndNot(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v7.AndNot(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w1[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v9.AndNot(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w1[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v11.AndNot(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func AndNotScalar(dst, a []byte, mask byte) {
	_vcUint8s2 := simd.BroadcastUint8s(mask)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, len(dst), 0, len(a)) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] &^ mask
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint8s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c2)
					_v1.AndNot(_vcUint8s2).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.AndNot(_vcUint8s2).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.AndNot(_vcUint8s2).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.AndNot(_vcUint8s2).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint8s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.AndNot(_vcUint8s2).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadUint8sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.AndNot(_vcUint8s2).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func Feasible(feasible, used, adjacent Colors) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(feasible, used, 0, len(feasible), 0, len(used)) || _loopvecOverlap(feasible, adjacent, 0, len(feasible), 0, len(adjacent)) {
		for w := range feasible {
			feasible[w] = used[w] &^ adjacent[w]
		}
	} else {
		if len(feasible) > 0 {
			_ = used[len(feasible)-1]
			_ = adjacent[len(feasible)-1]
			{
				_w1 := feasible[:len(feasible):len(feasible)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3 := used[:_count:_count], adjacent[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint64s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c3)
					_v1.AndNot(_v2).Store(_c1)
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v3.AndNot(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v5.AndNot(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
					_v7.AndNot(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadUint64s(_w2[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadUint64s(_w3[_i:])
					_v9.AndNot(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadUint64sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadUint64sPart(_w3[_i:])
					_v11.AndNot(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi int) bool {
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size < bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size && bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size < aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	// The operands are unequal on purpose: a &^ b and b &^ a differ.
	a := []uint64{0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0, 0xFFFF0000FFFF0000, 1, 2, 3, 0xFF, 0, ^uint64(0), 5}
	b := []uint64{0xFF00FF00FF00FF00, 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F, 3, 1, 3, 0x0F, ^uint64(0), 0, 4}
	dst := make([]uint64, len(a))
	test.AndNotUint64s(dst, a, b)
	fmt.Printf("%#x\n", dst)

	x := []int32{-1, 0x7FFF, 12, -8, 255, 3, 100, -100, 7}
	m := []int32{0xF0, -1, 4, 6, 0x0F, 3, 64, 1, 0}
	test.AndNotInPlace(x, m)
	fmt.Println(x)

	src := []byte("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789")
	out := make([]byte, len(src))
	test.AndNotScalar(out, src, 0x20)
	fmt.Println(string(out))

	f := make(test.Colors, 5)
	test.Feasible(f, test.Colors{0b1111, 0b1010, 0b0110, 0, 0b1}, test.Colors{0b0101, 0b1000, 0b0110, 0b1, 0})
	fmt.Println(f)
}
-- testmain/output --
[0xf000f000f000f0 0xf0f00000f0f00000 0x0 0x2 0x0 0xf0 0x0 0xffffffffffffffff 0x1]
[-241 0 8 -8 240 0 36 -100 7]
ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
[10 2 0 0 1]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 4 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

type Colors []uint64

func AndNotUint64s(dst, a, b []uint64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] &^ b[i]
	}
}

func AndNotInPlace(dst []int32, mask []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] &^= mask[i]
	}
}

func AndNotScalar(dst, a []byte, mask byte) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] &^ mask
	}
}

func Feasible(feasible, used, adjacent Colors) {
	for w := range feasible {
		feasible[w] = used[w] &^ adjacent[w]
	}
}
